summary: Iteration 3 backend testing of EtOH P0 production blockers (Sentry + Stripe webhook idempotency). 23/23 pytest tests PASS (100%) in /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_sentry_hub.py covering: Health (GET /api/), Sentry capture path (/api/debug/sentry → 500), Auth signup/login/me, Coach short FR message (200 + reply), Studio linkedin_post (>50 char content), Pilot v2 search (≥4 targets for 'cavistes Lyon vins bio') + email draft (subject + body), Hub /me (slug + company + items), Hub items CRUD (create→patch→delete + 404 after delete), public hub view WITHOUT auth, Hub extract from FR text (products_created≥1), CRM contacts list 200, Wallet packs (starter/growth/pro), Wallet checkout returns a Stripe TEST URL (https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_…), Stripe webhook (no sig→400, forged sig→400, valid HMAC-signed checkout.session.completed→200 received:true + credits +100, replay same event_id→200 received:true duplicate:true and credits unchanged, MongoDB wallet_events row written exactly once), Coach rate limit (30/min) trips 429 under 40 concurrent hits, Profile auto-extract learns target_countries=['USA','Japon'] from 'Nous exportons aux États-Unis et au Japon'. The Sentry FastAPI middleware wraps the app correctly (visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log stack trace showing 'sentry_sdk/integrations/fastapi.py' in the call chain) and does NOT break any existing endpoint. Idempotency is provided by the `stripe_events` unique index on `event_id` — on duplicate insert the InsertOne raises and the handler short-circuits with {received:true, duplicate:true} BEFORE re-crediting. Stripe-Signature verification uses stripe.Webhook.construct_event() with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_QVCyl4ZUwgAqGrcVGT72D887khZoLFh5 and rejects both missing and forged signatures with 400.
action_items: OPTIONAL: /api/debug/sentry should be gated behind an env flag (e.g. SENTRY_DEBUG_ENABLED=true) or removed before production deploy — currently anyone hitting it can trigger an uncaught exception (intentional, but should not ship to prod).

OPTIONAL: server.py is now 2614 lines — already flagged in iteration 2. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, profile, coach, studio, pilot, hub, crm, wallet, stripe) before adding more endpoints. Maintenance and route discovery is getting painful.

OPTIONAL: The Stripe webhook handler swallows the duplicate-key exception with a bare `except Exception:` (server.py L457) which would also mask any unrelated Mongo error and falsely return duplicate:true. Tighten to `except DuplicateKeyError` from pymongo.errors.
OPTIONAL: llm_rate_limit uses an in-memory dict (_USER_HITS) — works fine on a single backend pod but breaks under horizontal scaling. Move to Redis/Mongo TTL collection before scaling out.
critical_code_review_comments: Sentry init runs BEFORE FastAPI() in server.py — correct order, the middleware wraps every route including the new /api/stripe/webhook. _filter_event() correctly drops 4xx HTTPException to avoid noise from 401/429/400 webhook signature failures.

Stripe webhook idempotency: stripe_events has a UNIQUE INDEX on event_id (L1613) AND a 90-day TTL on received_at (L1614). The duplicate-insert path returns {received:true, duplicate:true} without crediting — verified by test_replay_is_idempotent: credits unchanged between the first call and the replay of the same event_id.
Belt-and-suspenders: even after the stripe_events insert succeeds, the code re-checks wallet_events for the session_id before crediting (L474). Defense-in-depth against partial Mongo writes.

Stripe webhook accepts payloads at BOTH /api/wallet/webhook (legacy) and /api/stripe/webhook (canonical) — both verified with test_no_signature_returns_400 on the canonical path. The duplicate-decorator pattern @app.post(...) @app.post(...) on the same handler works correctly in FastAPI.

Signature verification uses stripe.Webhook.construct_event() — the canonical Stripe SDK helper. Both 'missing' and 'forged' headers raise SignatureVerificationError which is re-raised as HTTPException(400) with 'invalid webhook signature: ...' detail.

Email/phone/linkedin sanitisation in /pilot/search (L1226-1232) — the iteration-2 bug fix is correctly in place: parenthetical suffixes like '(suggestion à valider)' are stripped from email, phone, linkedin_url, contact_name before the response is returned. Email draft test confirms targets are usable downstream.
All Mongo reads in webhook handler use {'_id': 0} or explicit projections — no ObjectId leakage. Webhook response is purely {received: bool, duplicate?: bool} — no PII exposed.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded vigneron@etoh-test.com. Test webhook flow: (1) deleted any prior stripe_events row for event_id=evt_test_<random> and wallet_events row for cs_test_TESTWEBHOOK1 before the test, (2) crafted a synthetic checkout.session.completed payload signed with whsec_QVCyl4ZUwgAqGrcVGT72D887khZoLFh5 via HMAC-SHA256, (3) verified +100 credits on first hit then 0 delta on replay, (4) cleanup step removes both rows. After all tests, restored user.credits to 100 (clean baseline) and noted that profile auto-extract set business_profile.target_countries=['USA','Japon'] — left as-is since that's the intended behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://ai-coach-autopilot.preview.emergentagent.com. The test user vigneron@etoh-test.com is seeded with credits=100 (restored at end of run) and business_profile.target_countries=['USA','Japon'] (set by the auto-extract test — clear it to [] before re-running TestProfileAutoExtract). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_sentry_hub.py -v` (~134s, requires MongoClient on localhost:27017 for credit-delta assertions and event/wallet_events cleanup). The rate-limit test uses ThreadPoolExecutor(15) to fire 40 concurrent /api/coach/message hits — relies on the in-memory _USER_HITS deque so a fresh backend restart resets the counter (was needed once during this iteration). STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is hardcoded in the test file as a constant (whsec_QVCyl4ZUwgAqGrcVGT72D887khZoLFh5) matching backend/.env. Webhook payloads are HMAC-SHA256-signed manually with stdlib hmac/hashlib — no need for the stripe SDK on the test side.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all 23 tests pass, no production bugs found this iteration. One non-blocking observation: server.py L457 catches a bare `except Exception:` for the stripe_events insert and assumes it's a duplicate-key. If Mongo ever throws something else (network blip, schema validation error if added later) the handler would falsely return {received: true, duplicate: true} and skip crediting. Tighten to `except DuplicateKeyError:` (from pymongo.errors).
